rules: Width must be 35-40mm and face must take up 70-80% of the photograph — both confirmed directly from ICP's (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security) own 'Personal Photo Specifications' PDF on 2026-09-13. SpecShot targets 35mm, the smallest size within that accepted width range.

HEIGHT NOT STATED: the source gives width (35-40mm) and a face-coverage percentage but no explicit height in mm. 45mm above is a conventional ICAO portrait-ratio assumption, not read from the source. Head height (32-36mm) is likewise derived from the confirmed 70-80% rule applied to that assumed height, not an independently published mm figure.

Background must be a 'plain light-coloured background' (exact wording from the source) — not specifically 'white'. White is a light colour and is the common real-world choice, but isn't textually mandated the way it is for UK/Canada/Australia/China. A different figure (43x55mm) is commonly cited elsewhere specifically for 'UAE visa photos', but this session could not confirm it against any UAE government page — ICP's own confirmed 35-40mm width is used instead.

This ICP document is titled generically 'Personal Photo Specifications', not visa-specific, and may be the same standard ICP applies across its services (Emirates ID, visas, residency) rather than a visa-only rule.
Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open; head not tilted, both edges of face visible; no other people or objects in frame; recent, taken within 6 months
Head coverings permitted only for religious reasons, full face from chin to forehead still visible; glasses must show eyes clearly with no tinted lenses or flash glare
